title: Lighttpd lifecycle fixture input lacks verified runtime-root containment
security_assessment: validated_local_cli_artifact_boundary; no remote HTTP arbitrary-file-read path was demonstrated
protocol: patched Lighttpd lifecycle runtime artifact handling
profile: SonarQube Cloud current Parent issue AZ9cRymfHhV2CayPTPzM / pythonsecurity:S8707
summary: SonarQube Cloud issue AZ9cRymfHhV2CayPTPzM reported that the Lighttpd lifecycle writer read the CLI-selected --entity-fixture-result through Path.read_text without proving it belonged to the verified private runtime root. The task patch confines that fixture and every other data-bearing lifecycle input to an absolute existing regular non-symlink artifact below the root, then reads fixture JSON through the existing descriptor-relative no-follow control.
summary_de: SonarQube-Cloud-Issue AZ9cRymfHhV2CayPTPzM meldete, dass der Lighttpd-Lifecycle-Writer das per CLI gewählte --entity-fixture-result über Path.read_text las, ohne seine Zugehörigkeit zum verifizierten privaten Runtime-Root zu beweisen. Der Task-Patch begrenzt dieses Fixture und alle weiteren datenführenden Lifecycle-Inputs auf ein absolutes vorhandenes reguläres Nicht-Symlink-Artefakt unterhalb der Root und liest das Fixture-JSON anschließend durch den bestehenden descriptor-relativen No-Follow-Control.
observed_behavior: Before the patch, a direct lifecycle-helper invocation could pass an unrelated readable path as --entity-fixture-result. The checked-in canonical runner normally creates the fixture under its private smoke directory, but the helper did not enforce this invariant. Sonar classified the item as a HIGH security impact vulnerability at write_patched_lifecycle_results.py:208.
observed_behavior_de: Vor dem Patch konnte ein direkter Lifecycle-Helper-Aufruf einen unabhängigen lesbaren Pfad als --entity-fixture-result übergeben. Der eingecheckte kanonische Runner erzeugt das Fixture normalerweise unter seinem privaten Smoke-Verzeichnis, aber der Helper erzwang diese Invariante nicht. Sonar klassifizierte das Item als Vulnerability mit HIGH Security Impact in write_patched_lifecycle_results.py:208.
expected_behavior: Every lifecycle data input must be an absolute, existing regular non-symlink file below the verified private runtime root before it is consumed. The fixture reader must not follow a substituted symlink and no lifecycle result, projection, or summary may be published after an invalid input is supplied.
expected_behavior_de: Jeder Lifecycle-Dateninput muss vor seiner Verarbeitung eine absolute vorhandene reguläre Nicht-Symlink-Datei unterhalb des verifizierten privaten Runtime-Roots sein. Der Fixture-Leser darf keinem substituierten Symlink folgen, und nach einem ungültigen Input dürfen kein Lifecycle-Resultat, keine Projection und keine Summary publiziert werden.
impact: The confirmed boundary is local developer/CI/operator CLI artifact selection. No repository evidence establishes a remote HTTP peer, separate lower-privilege process, or cross-tenant actor able to select the path. The severity is therefore low despite Sonar's generic HIGH impact label; the task does not claim a remote arbitrary-file-read exploit.
impact_de: Die bestätigte Grenze ist die lokale Auswahl eines CLI-Artefakts durch Developer/CI/Operator. Keine Repository-Evidence belegt einen Remote-HTTP-Peer, separaten Prozess mit niedrigeren Privilegien oder Cross-Tenant-Akteur, der den Pfad wählen kann. Die Schwere ist daher trotz Sonars generischem HIGH-Impact-Label niedrig; der Task beansprucht keinen Remote-Arbitrary-File-Read-Exploit.
preconditions: A direct caller can supply an absolute --entity-fixture-result path to the lifecycle helper.
The pre-fix lifecycle helper is in use.
For a material boundary impact, the caller must be distinct from the identity that owns the private runtime root; no such repository path was evidenced.
reproduction: Inspect the retained Sonar issue JSON for key AZ9cRymfHhV2CayPTPzM and source line 208.
Run the focused lifecycle event-validation suite; its hostile controls supply outside-root and symlink paths for all six data-bearing options and assert rejection before output publication.
Run the legitimate in-root lifecycle control and verify its existing projection and summary behavior remains valid.

root_cause: load_fixture_result called Path.read_text on a CLI-selected path without a verified-root containment or descriptor-relative no-follow read. The other lifecycle data inputs similarly lacked an explicit root-bound precondition before use.
root_cause_de: load_fixture_result rief Path.read_text auf einem CLI-ausgewählten Pfad ohne verifizierte Root-Begrenzung oder descriptor-relativen No-Follow-Read auf. Auch den übrigen Lifecycle-Dateninputs fehlte vor ihrer Nutzung eine explizite an die Root gebundene Voraussetzung.
proposed_remediation: Validate all six data-bearing lifecycle paths with runtime_artifact_path(..., must_exist=True) through Lighttpd-local adapters, and read the fixture through read_runtime_artifact_text. Preserve the existing atomic output path and add direct hostile and legitimate CLI regressions. Do not change Sonar policy, exclusions, NOSONAR, suppression, Framework, MRTS, or Gitlinks.
proposed_remediation_de: Alle sechs datenführenden Lifecycle-Pfade über Lighttpd-lokale Adapter mit runtime_artifact_path(..., must_exist=True) validieren und das Fixture über read_runtime_artifact_text lesen. Den bestehenden atomaren Output-Pfad erhalten und direkte hostile sowie legitime CLI-Regressionen hinzufügen. Keine Sonar-Policy, Exclusions, NOSONAR, Suppression, Framework, MRTS oder Gitlinks ändern.
acceptance_criteria: Every data-bearing lifecycle input is rejected when it is outside the verified root, a symlink, missing, or non-regular where required.
The fixture read uses the descriptor-confined no-follow helper.
The legitimate lifecycle control and 17 host-contract controls pass.
Exact PR-head SonarQube Cloud analysis must prove the original issue absent, zero New Issues, and zero New-Code duplication before any merge consideration.
validation_plan: Run the focused event-validation and host-contract suites, Python compilation, and whitespace check on the exact branch head.
Complete a security-diff review of all changed source-like files and retain its sealed report.
After creating the draft PR, read the exact GitHub head, required checks, Sonar quality gate, original issue key, and new-code duplication measures.
dependencies: No current dependency within the requested draft-PR scope; resulting-master evidence would be required only after a separately authorized merge.
residual_risk: The patch does not prove or claim a remote HTTP exploit. Event JSONL readers still use normal reads after private-root validation; under the documented current-user-owned, non-group/world-writable root this is same-identity defense-in-depth rather than a demonstrated separate-actor vulnerability. Exact Draft-PR hosted evidence is verified; resulting-master evidence is not yet applicable because no merge was requested or performed.
residual_risk_de: Der Patch beweist und beansprucht keinen Remote-HTTP-Exploit. Event-JSONL-Leser verwenden nach der Private-Root-Validierung weiterhin normale Reads; unter der dokumentierten current-user-owned, nicht group/world-writable Root ist dies Same-Identity-Defense-in-Depth und keine nachgewiesene Vulnerability für einen separaten Akteur. Exact-Draft-PR-Hosted-Evidence ist verifiziert; Resulting-Master-Evidence ist noch nicht anwendbar, weil kein Merge beantragt oder ausgeführt wurde.
